title: Day 1 — Comeback
subtitle: Full Body · Light
notice: Today's goal: Wake the muscles up, not break them down. Use 60–70% of your old weights. Focus on form and feel. Stop 1–2 reps before failure on every set. No soreness is a win today.
warmup: 5 min treadmill brisk walk or light jog
10 bodyweight squats (light, just to open hips)
closing: Tomorrow: Rest or light walk. No gym. Muscles rebuild during rest. Come back Day 3 and we'll step it up slightly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.tip: Form: Pull bar to upper chest, lean back slightly. Squeeze lats at bottom. Control the return — don't let it snap back. No momentum.

alt.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
alt.tip: Plant one knee and hand on a bench. Pull dumbbell up to hip, elbow close to body. Same muscles, full range of motion. No cable needed.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.tip: Why machine today: Safer coming back — no stabilizer fatigue risk. Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest. Full extension but don't lock elbows out.

alt.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
alt.tip: Lie flat on a bench. Dumbbells at chest level, elbows at ~45°. Press up and together. More stabilizer work than the machine — use slightly lighter weight.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.tip: Form: Sit tall, chest up. Pull handle to lower sternum, elbows close to body. Squeeze shoulder blades together at end. Don't round forward on the return.

alt.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
alt.tip: Hinge at hips, back flat, knees slightly bent. Hold dumbbells and row both up together to lower ribcage. Squeeze shoulder blades. Keep core tight — don't let back round.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.tip: Form: Press straight up — don't flare elbows too wide. Stop just short of full lockout. Keep core braced so you're not arching back to push.

alt.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
alt.tip: Sit upright on a bench, back supported. Dumbbells at ear height, elbows at 90°. Press straight up without flaring too wide. Don't arch your lower back — brace core first.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.tip: Form: Supinate (rotate) as you curl up — palms face ceiling at top. Elbows stay pinned at your sides. Lower slowly: 2 counts down.

alt.name: Barbell Curl
alt.tip: Straight bar, shoulder-width grip, palms up. Curl up keeping elbows pinned at sides. Barbell forces both arms to work equally — great for symmetry.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.tip: Form: Elbows pinned to sides, don't move them. Push straight down until arms are fully extended. Control back up. Use rope or straight bar — both fine today.

alt.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
alt.tip: Hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead, arms straight. Bend elbows to lower it behind your head, then press back up. Keep upper arms still — only forearms move.

title: Day 3 — Upper Body
subtitle: Push/Pull · Moderate
notice: Today: You survived Day 1. Now add a little. Real working weight on the first two lifts — still leave 1–2 reps in the tank. If Day 1 left you sore, drop a set anywhere. Check a set and the rest timer starts automatically and shows what's coming next.
warmup: 5 min incline treadmill walk or rowing machine
1 light warm-up set on first lift

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.tip: Form: Bench at 30–45°. Press dumbbells up and slightly together. Don't bounce off chest. This hits upper chest the machine press skipped Day 1.

alt.name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
alt.tip: Same angle, barbell version. Lock the bench, grip just outside shoulders, lower to upper chest. Need a spotter or safety arms for the last set.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.tip: Form: Grip wider than shoulders. Pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down and back. Lean back ~15°. Stretch fully at top each rep.

alt.name: Bent-Over Two-DB Row
alt.tip: Hinge at hips, flat back. Row both dumbbells to your ribcage, elbows tight. Hits lats and mid-back when no cable is free.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.tip: Form: Sit tall, chest up. Pull to lower sternum, squeeze blades together. Slow return, feel the stretch. No jerking with lower back.

alt.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
alt.tip: Knee and hand on bench, flat back. Pull dumbbell to hip, elbow close. One side at a time fixes left/right imbalances.

exercises.name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
exercises.tip: Form: Start palms facing you at chin. Rotate out as you press up. Hits all three delt heads. Go lighter than a normal press — the rotation is harder.

alt.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
alt.tip: Skip the rotation. Dumbbells at ear height, press straight up. Simpler and lets you load a bit heavier if shoulders feel good.

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise
exercises.tip: Form: Slight bend in elbows. Raise to shoulder height, lead with elbows not hands. Control down slowly. Light weight — ego has no place here.

alt.name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
alt.tip: Single cable across body, raise out to the side. Constant tension the whole range. Use if dumbbells are taken.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.tip: Form: Neutral grip — palms face each other the whole time. Elbows pinned. Builds the brachialis for thicker-looking arms. Lower slow.

alt.name: Barbell Curl
alt.tip: Straight or EZ bar, shoulder-width. Both arms work equally. Keep elbows still, no swinging.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
exercises.tip: Form: Elbows pinned to sides. Push down and split the rope apart at the bottom for a harder squeeze. Control back up — don't let it yank you.

alt.name: DB Overhead Triceps Extension
alt.tip: One dumbbell, both hands, overhead. Lower behind head, press up. Hits the long head harder than pushdowns.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.tip: Form: Rope at face height. Pull toward your forehead, hands splitting apart, elbows high. The best move for shoulder health and posture. Finish here.

alt.name: Bent-Over DB Rear Delt Raise
alt.tip: Hinge forward, light dumbbells. Raise out to the sides squeezing rear delts. Same target, no cable.

title: Day 4 — Legs
subtitle: Lower Body · Light
notice: Today — legs are back: First real lower session in over two months. The bike woke them up Tuesday but that's not the same as loading them. Go LIGHT, full range, control everything. Expect some soreness Sunday — that's normal. If anything pinches in a knee, stop that move and use the alternative.
warmup: 5 min bike or incline walk to warm the legs

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.tip: Form: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Lower until knees at 90°, don't let them cave in. Push through the whole foot. Back stays flat on the pad.

alt.name: Goblet Squat
alt.tip: Hold one dumbbell at your chest. Squat down between your knees, chest up, heels down. Easier on the back than a barbell and great for grooving the pattern back in.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.tip: Form: Hips flat on the pad. Curl smoothly, don't jerk. Squeeze at the top. Lower slowly — 2-3 counts. Don't let your hips rise off the pad.

alt.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
alt.tip: Dumbbells in front of thighs, soft knees. Push hips back, lower the weights along your legs until you feel the hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward. Back stays flat.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.tip: Form: Adjust pad to just above ankles. Extend fully, squeeze quads at the top. Lower controlled — don't let it drop. High reps, light weight today.

alt.name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
alt.tip: One foot forward, one back. Drop straight down, front knee tracks over the foot. A dumbbell in each hand. Unilateral work fixes side-to-side weakness.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.tip: Form: Soft knees, push hips back not down. Bar or dumbbells stay close to your legs. Feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom. Drive hips forward to stand — don't use your back.

alt.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
alt.tip: Upper back on a bench, bar over hips (use a pad). Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at the top, chin tucked. Easier on the lower back than RDLs if it feels cranky.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.tip: Form: Full range — all the way up on tiptoes, all the way down for a stretch. Slow and controlled. Pause at the top. Calves need range more than load.

alt.name: Dumbbell Step-Ups
alt.tip: Dumbbell each hand, step onto a flat bench, drive through the heel, stand tall, control back down. Hits calves, quads and glutes if the calf machine is taken.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.tip: Form: Forearms down, body straight from head to heels. Squeeze glutes and brace like you're about to take a punch. Don't let hips sag or pike. Breathe.

alt.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
alt.tip: If you'd rather end on legs than core: dumbbells at your sides, step forward into a lunge, alternate. Keep torso upright. Skip if quads are already torched.
